description: Routes, chemins : site de Kerbernez (ORE AgrHyS) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geosas.fr. Representation of the roads and paths of the INRA study site in Kerbernez. The roads were traced from IGN 2011 orthophotograph and scan 25 IGN 2011. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Roads, roads: Kerbernez website (ORE AgrHyS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
